summary: qzc690385 setup.py exploits local Xinference service and exfiltrates PID1 cmdline on install
details: On pip install, setup.py of qzc690385 1.0.3 POSTs to http://127.0.0.1:9997/v1/model_registrations/flexible to register a 'flexible' model whose launcher is set to xinference.model.flexible.launchers.transformers_launcher.launcher, abusing a locally reachable Xinference instance to load/execute an attacker-chosen launcher spec. A second registration embeds the output of `cat /proc/1/cmdline | tr '\0' ' ' | head -c 40` into the registration name, leaking host/container identity (PID1 command line, which typically reveals the container image, orchestrator, or entrypoint) into the attacked service's persistent model registry. The shipped package has no real functionality: __init__.py is a single `#c` comment and metadata is blank, consistent with a proof-of-concept exploit payload rather than a library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
